restores: The follower's retain sets the visited bit with its right, so a joined acquisition refused `Closed` during its reservation earns a policy hit.

miss_cause.evidence: The plant's refused joined read earns a hit only when a storage close lands between the follower's two cutoff reads inside one synchronous joined acquisition, and every order in which the plant's visited bit differs from the head's needs a second thread, which the one-thread, turn-level sweep worker cannot schedule; at commit 6240a6fd9 scratch traces fired at the planted `retain_right` in all 116,874 upload, 92,257 faulted, 41,304 cluster-broad and 47,866 cluster-pressure runs and in 44,419 of 44,421 cluster-swarm runs, at the joined reservation in 3,304 of 33,768 cluster-broad, 46,071 of 49,319 cluster-pressure, 6,117 of 11,215 cluster-swarm and 7,440 of 7,812 cluster-long runs and in no upload or faulted run, at the follower's two `Closed` refusals in none of 270,729 upload, 203,600 faulted, 57,693 cluster-broad, 22,918 cluster-pressure and 9,206 cluster-swarm runs, and at the refusal after the reservation in none of 2,266 cluster-long runs, where the refusal before it was not traced; `cluster-long` stays out of `expected` because the profile has no passing run at the default counts.
